residualNotes: Real product copy and neutral test data. Coverage ring shows N of M checks done only (no score). Passed replaced with result vocabulary counts (no issue observed / attention / defects). Removed Bay and VIN fragment; vehicle photo replaced with car icon; Active Bay/Queued replaced with Done/In progress/Not started derived from assessments; categories are template-driven. Ring arc uses brand fill with numeric fallback. Visual differences from removed Figma elements are residuals.
